text.title: One day in Pamukkale for 1,890 lira

cafe.name: Teras Restaurant, Tekke
cafe.order: serpme kahvaltı, the full Turkish spread
cafe.when: opens 08:00 daily, after the 6:30 terrace walk

dish.name: Denizli tandır kebab
dish.tip: Eat in the village; the gate restaurants charge far more

spot.name: the travertine terraces
spot.how: South Gate, barefoot on the terrace path

items: Travertines, Hierapolis and museum entry — 700 TL
Dolmuş from Denizli otogar, return — 100 TL
Tandır kebab at Tıkır Grill House — 400 TL
Pomegranate juice at the gate — 40 TL

text.mistake: The ticket is single entry. Step out for lunch, or back to the car for a forgotten swimsuit, and you buy a whole second €30 ticket.
text.close: Send this to whoever packs lace-up shoes
